In partnership with the Integrated Training Service (ITS) of the Department of Peace Operations (DPO) the project aims to customize and deploy a complete Unite Aware training environment accessible to authorized users on the internet to support all instructor-led courses, whether virtual or in-person taking place in any facility, including Member States Peacekeeping Training Centres. Duties and Responsibilities This position is part of the United Nations Office of Information and Communication Technology's Enterprise Solutions Service (OICT/ESS). The incumbent reports to and works under the supervision of the Technical Lead of Unite Aware. The Data Engineering Specialist will be responsible for the following duties: · Architect, analyze, integrate and manage data in order to build data models and data driven insights to generate significant organizational value; · Implement data collection and integration procedures to gather information that is relevant for building and embedding analytic systems into user portals; · Create models and processes to collect, distill and interpret data with a view to aid better, more informed decision making; · Analyze a broad range of existing data sources; · Examine and explore data from multiple disparate sources; · Analyze and implement data pipelines to bring data from databases and APIs into the analytics platform; · Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis; · Design and implement data marts and data pipelines using hybrid cloud technologies; · Develop tabular cubes, database views, datasets and dataflows to expose data to visualization tools; · Build machine learning solutions for monitoring, detection, automation and forecasting; · Write documentation and prepare training materials; · Perform other duties as required Education: Advanced University degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems / Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field. We will consider a first level university degree with a combination of relevant academic qualifications and experience. Language: Fluency in spoken and written English is required. Experience Required: · A minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible professional experience in the field of Information and Communication Technologies, Engineering or other related fields is required. · A minimum of three (3) years of experience in development, implementation and maintenance of data systems, integrations and ETLs or related areas is required; · A minimum of three (3) years of experience with Microsoft SQL or other relational databases; · A minimum of three (3) years of experience with MS Fabric; · A minimum of three (3) years of experience developing with MS Microsoft SQL Server Integration · A minimum of three (3) years of experience in data transformation with Python; · Experience developing data models with DAX or MDX in MS SQL Server Analysis Services or Power BI; · Experience leveraging Generative AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate data transformation, scripting (Python, DAX, SQL), and data modeling; · Experience in database modeling and datamart design; We would also like you to have: · Experience in programming with C# and .Net; · Experience with MS machine learning and AI solutions; · Experience in REST APIs; · Familiarity with data automation techniques; · Familiarity with big data frameworks such as Spark and Hadoop; · Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies; The position is either based in Valencia, Spain if you already have the right to work in Spain, or can be remote in Europe.

review_candidates.title: B2B Senior Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Vacancy: B2B Technical Sales Engineer – Lubricants & Spare Parts Location: Cairo, Egypt                          Level: Mid Commercial Level Industry: Industrial & Automotive Lubricants and Spare Parts Job Description: We are looking for a Senior Technical Sales Engineer – B2B - to develop new business and support existing customers by providing the right technical and commercial solutions for their lubricant and spare-parts requirements. The role combines technical knowledge with consultative B2B selling and requires regular customer visits and strong understanding of industrial and automotive applications. Key Responsibilities: Develop new B2B business and maintain strong relationships with customers. Identify companies with internal lubricant consumption, including factories, fleet owners, commercial service centers, schools, universities, travel agencies, and other companies consuming lubricants and spare parts. Visit customers to understand their equipment, applications, operating conditions, and lubricant requirements. Recommend suitable lubricant and spare-parts products based on customer applications and technical requirements. Present technical and commercial solutions to customers and decision-makers. Prepare quotations and follow up on opportunities from initial contact through order confirmation. Achieve assigned sales and business-development targets. Conduct product presentations and technical discussions with customers when required. Work closely with the Technical Support team to address complex customer requirements. Monitor competitor products, market developments, and customer feedback. Maintain accurate records of customer visits, opportunities, quotations, and sales activities. Follow up with customers to ensure satisfaction and identify additional business opportunities.   Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Automotive, Petroleum, or related Engineering discipline. 2–5 years of relevant B2B sales experience is mandatory. Experience in lubricants, automotive products, spare parts, industrial products, or related technical products is highly preferred. Good understanding of automotive and/or industrial lubricant applications. Strong technical selling and problem-solving skills. Highly organized with an excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, reporting and interpersonal skills. Commercially minded with a strong interest in business development and achieving targets. Good command of English. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office. Must own a car and hold a valid driving license.   Compensation & Benefits: Basic salary based on experience. Sales commission versus target achievements. Annual incentive based on performance & KPIs achievements.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer II - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
review_candidates.description: Who You'll Work With Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact You will work with clients across a wide range of sectors and industries, advising them on how to best leverage technology. You will drive architectural design, make key technology decisions, and employ agile methodologies to build and deliver the next generation of products for our clients at scale. You will also lead project workstreams, helping clients build their technical capabilities and foster a culture centered around engineering best practices, user-centricity, and Agile values. As a core member of the team, you will take on responsibilities that include driving architectural design and making strategic technology decisions to shape next-generation products for various internal teams, ensuring that we remain at the forefront of technological innovation. Additionally, you will be hands-on and co-creating solutions alongside our clients and their leadership, enabling you to grow into a recognized technology leader. You will be part of the Middle East McKinsey Tech & AI team in Cairo. This group brings together the best of McKinsey’s Tech & AI capabilities to help our clients use digital technology to transform their businesses. Tech & AI at McKinsey is our tech delivery people unit. A global team of software, data and cloud engineers, passionate designers, technology architects, product owners, and leading technologists. You will join a multidisciplinary community of developers, Agile coaches, designers, business strategists and experts. Together, we’ll design and create industry shaping products and tools for our clients. Our office culture is casual and social, with an emphasis on education and innovation. You will have the freedom to try new ideas and experiment in your role and will be guaranteed significant dedicated time to tinker, create, continuously learn and share cool new stuff. We also have a strong emphasis in our teams on mentoring others enabling them to grow and learn. Changing the world requires us to sit with our clients at times, so some travel is expected while in this role. Your Qualifications and Skills Undergraduate or master’s degree; or equivalent experience 3+ years of experience in software development, with significant full-stack web application development experience strongly preferred Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience across the full application stack with some of the following languages/frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, jQuery, Java, Sprint, C#, .NET, Node.js, SQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, cloud-native databases, AWS, Azure, GCP, Jenkins, Docker, Circle CI, Travis Experience leading in Agile teams, including coaching and modeling Agile mindsets as part of sprint ceremonies, work definition and building developer capabilities Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members and stakeholders including modeling and coaching others to use engineering best practices such as design patterns, customer-centric design, test-driven development, code refactoring, code review, and OWASP Top 10 security awareness

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Developer
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Fullstack Developer with strong backend expertise and a solid understanding of system architecture and performance optimization. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling high-performance applications, while ensuring reliability and maintainability across both backend and frontend systems Responsibilities: Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. Build and optimize backend systems using PHP (Laravel or CodeIgniter). Design scalable system architecture (e.g., microservices or event-driven). Optimize database performance (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and manage NoSQL databases when needed. Implement asynchronous processes (e.g., AWS SQS) and caching strategies (Redis). Perform testing (unit, integration, and basic performance testing). Identify and fix performance bottlenecks. Collaborate with the team and take ownership of features from development to deployment. Utilize AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve development efficiency. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience building and scaling production applications using PHP (Laravel or CodeIgniter). Strong understanding of architectural patterns (e.g., Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, or Hexagonal Architecture). Experience designing systems for high availability and fault tolerance. Deep experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL, specifically in query optimization, indexing strategies, and schema design for performance. Hands-on experience with CouchDB, Firebase, or DynamoDB, understanding when to use NoSQL over SQL. Proficiency in asynchronous processing using message brokers like AWS SQS. Experience implementing advanced caching strategies and data structures using Redis. Experience with automated testing (Unit, Integration) and load/performance testing (e.g., k6, JMeter) to identify and resolve system bottlenecks. Proficiency in using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate development cycles and maintain high code quality. Self-motivated and capable of owning complex features from architectural design to deployment while collaborating in an agile environment. Professional proficiency in English. Nice-To-Have: Experience with Node.js (NestJS), Python (Django/FastAPI), or Golang. Familiarity with integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex. Experience with AWS services beyond SQS (e.g., Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache). Experience with monitoring and tracing tools (e.g., New Relic, Datadog, or Prometheus) to troubleshoot production performance issues.
